document.abstract: A ship is only as good as its captain–and the same goes for our Society. The SMPTE has flourished in its 75 years as a result of strong leaders who were committed to the betterment of the Society and the expansion of its membership, and who have devoted themselves to establishing industry standards. As a tribute to these leaders, and to the SMPTE's 75th anniversary the Journal invited Former Presidents to reflect on the Society then and now.
